items.title: Ed Soph interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 9, 2024
items.q: with a lot of good drummers: Malcolm Pinson; a great drummer named Carl Lott who’s still alive, a great drummer; Richie Lockwood

ctx.x: Yeah. Yeah. And once I got in the network then I started playing — I became a night person, it’s a wonder I made it through school because I was playing a lot of sessions

with a lot of good drummers: Malcolm Pinson; a great drummer named Carl Lott who’s still alive, a great drummer; Richie Lockwood, I don’t know what happened to Richie. But man, and there were at least four or five full time jazz clubs in Houston back then.
Did you get a reputation in your high school like you’re a cool cat, man?
